text: Let the verifier see the 'fails without the fix' run. Many acceptance criteria require a recorded run showing the new test fails on the old code, but the verifier receives no producer report and may not change files, so it can never see that run. Two tries of 'don't count needs-accepting re-reads toward the job limit' (jobs 20261103-193428-df2m and 20261103-222737-zzsr) were rejected only on this, although the code was correct and all checks passed. Fix it in one place: after the producer finishes, Athena itself runs each planned 'fails without the fix' demonstration (apply the planned revert to a scratch copy of the candidate, run the named test, record the command, exit code and output tail) and puts that record in the verifier's brief under 'Checks Athena ran'. Acceptance: a test where a plan has one such demonstration and the verifier brief contains its recorded failing run; a test where the revert does not make the test fail and the record says so.
